data.name: Idonah
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Idonai', which means 'Idol', but in Christian contexts, it is interpreted as 'God's grace' or 'kindness'. In Greek mythology, the name Idonai was associated with a goddess of the same name. However, in the Christian tradition, the name Idonah represents the divine grace and kindness bestowed upon us by God.

It was believed that Idonai, in its Christian interpretation, was a name that would remind its bearer of the divine grace that God extends to all of humanity, encouraging humility and gratitude.
